stages.effectText: In Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries , summon capacity +5 , and when summons are defeated or retreated, there is a 25% chance they are retrieved

Can use up to 5 summons (max 3 deployed at once), summons' effect changes based upon Skill; in [Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries], summons have 25% less Redeployment Time, and when defeated or retreated, Raidian recovers 1 SP

Can use up to 5 summons (max 3 deployed at once), summons' effect changes based upon Skill; in [Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries], summons have 50% less Redeployment Time, and when defeated or retreated, Raidian recovers 2 SP
In [ Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries ], Raidian attacks one additional target

Can use up to 5 summons (max 3 deployed at once), summons' effect changes based upon Skill; in [Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries], Raidian will retrieve summons in the 4 adjacent tiles, recovering 20% Max HP immediately, and her following attacks will deal an additional instance of Arts damage equal to 20% ATK (max 4 stacks)

Can use up to 5 summons (max 3 deployed at once), summons' effect changes based upon Skill; in [Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries], Raidian will retrieve summons in the 4 adjacent tiles, recovering 25% Max HP immediately, and her following attacks will deal an additional instance of Arts damage equal to 30% ATK (max 4 stacks)
